subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**evaporation**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**evaporation**" refers to the process where water is heated by the sun and turns into** water vapour**. (वाष्पीकरण)
 
• In the context of the water cycle, evaporation occurs when **water from oceans, lakes, and rivers is heated by the sun.**
 
• The other options: "**condensation**" happens after evaporation, "**sublimation**" is the transition of a substance from solid to gas, and "**liquefaction**" is the process of making something into a liquid, none of which fit the context for this particular stage of the water cycle.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *At the heart of the water cycle is the process of evaporation__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Condensation (संघनन)**: the process by which water vapour in the air is changed into liquid water.
 
• **Sublimation (उर्ध्वपातन)**: the transition of a substance directly from the solid to the gas state.
 
• **Liquefaction (द्रवीकरण)**: the process of making something into a liquid.
